instruction: I want to disable the background cone visualization in VLC. The animated cone in the background when no video is playing is distracting, and I prefer a clean, static interface.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the background cone visualization in VLC. Uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric function to verify the qt-bgcone setting is set to 0 (disabled) in the VLC configuration file.
